findings.summary: The baseline's six-property anatomy of a social credit system was replaced by a five-sentence functional sketch, severing the anatomy from the six bright lines built to answer it property by property.

evidence.baseline: It is centralized: a single authority, typically a state, holds the record and controls its meaning. It is comprehensive: it aggregates behavior across every domain of life into a single score or status. It is imposed... It is opaque... It is coercive by design... And it is unidirectional: the power flows from the authority to the individual, who is the object of measurement, never its owner.
evidence.shipped: The dangerous system aggregates behavior into standing controlled by an authority. Participation is difficult or impossible to refuse. Criteria are opaque or politically mutable. The record follows the person across unrelated domains. It gates fundamental goods and turns measurement into an instrument of compliance.

findings.diagnosis: The baseline's six named properties are the load-bearing frame of the whole chapter: each It cannot be line in the next section answers one property by name. The shipped sketch covers similar ground but names no property, so the shipped bright lines that followed it could drift to a different six. Restored in full; the anatomy and the lines now correspond one to one again.

findings.summary: The shipped depoliticization of the definition is real drafting and runs the other way, preserved here rather than kept.

evidence.baseline: A social credit system, in the sense the world has come to fear, has a specific and identifiable structure.
evidence.shipped: "Social credit" is used loosely in public debate. The relevant danger here is a functional pattern rather than a label attached to any one country. ... Providence becomes such a system if it acquires those functions, whatever its founders call it.

findings.authorizedBy: R-SUBSTITUTION-CREDIT for the recording; not kept in prose.
findings.diagnosis: The shipped framing does two things well: it detaches the danger from any single country, and its closing sentence turns the definition onto Providence itself, which is the sharpest sentence in the shipped chapter. It is not kept because the baseline's in the sense the world has come to fear does the bounding work inside the author's own frame, and the functions-not-labels doctrine is a new claim the baseline never makes. Both sentences are preserved here at full finding weight for the author to adopt if the depoliticized frame is wanted.

findings.diagnosis: The pair fenced an illustrative enumeration whose items carry internal commas, so paired commas would have dissolved the list into the sentence. Parentheses hold it as the genuinely incidental material the standard names, the only parenthetical in the chapter.
